question: Should this repository adopt Fuse.js 7.5.0's corrected scoring and ranking behavior for existing knowledge-base searches?
rationale: The dependency update is mechanically narrow and checks pass, but the upstream release explicitly changes observable search ordering, which requires repository-owner acceptance rather than a code repair.

options.title: Validate representative searches and merge
options.body: Compare a small set of important knowledge-base queries across both versions and accept the upgrade if the corrected ordering remains suitable.

options.title: Hold the current version
options.body: Keep 7.4.2 if preserving current search ordering is more important than adopting Fuse.js's scoring corrections now.

recommendation.title: Validate representative searches and merge
recommendation.body: Compare a small set of important knowledge-base queries across both versions and accept the upgrade if the corrected ordering remains suitable.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely repository-level owner for an intentional production dependency and search-quality tradeoff.
